summary:
Kit's v3 work is done, on top of my earlier session that the lead committed as 4f4f98d / 241a844. The build passes, the Act 1 and Act 2 e2e suites pass on WebGL 2, and Kit renders on WebGPU at Élevé. The WebGPU e2e suite gets 4 of 6: the 2 failures are a bug in the post pipeline's Ultra preset, not in Kit. Nothing was committed.

Already in place from the earlier session (src/30-player.js):
- A smooth sculpted body: one skinned mesh on the v2 rig, so pivots, poses and sizes are unchanged.
- Shell fur whose layer count follows K.gfx.furShells (16 / 10 / 6 / 0), with motion and wind lag.
- Generated fur and knit textures (tools/tex/kit_tex.py, written to assets/tex/kit/).
- Fluffy tail and cheek tufts, white chest and tail tip.
- Eyes with iris, cornea highlight, blinking lids and gaze; a glossy nose; a knitted scarf.
- Translucency (subsurface-style) lighting and a rim light.
- A detailed skateboard: deck graphics, grip tape, maple plies, trucks, rolling wheels.
- No PORT(kit) markers are left.

Changed this session (src/30-player.js only):
- **Wrap lighting.** Kit now follows the scene's sun and lets light reach a little past the lit/shadow boundary on the fur. The fur layers now use the same lighting as the body. This fixes a hard shading line across the head and a dark jagged fringe on the shadow side, which were very visible in the city at sunset and in the flight close-up (before/after: dev/kit/shots/cmp_fl.png).
- **Shield.** Now an iridescent bubble that is clear in the middle, so Kit stays readable inside it.
- **Speed-shoes afterimages.** Now glowing cyan silhouettes, brighter at the edges.
- **Économie preset (no fur layers).** The fur bump is softer, so the coat reads as velvet instead of speckled noise.

Verified, by reading the screenshots:
- Turntable and face close-ups, run, jump/ball, spin dash, hurt, victory wink, star + shoes, Act 2 skate, close-up, kickflip sequence and flight.
- Presets: Ultra, Élevé and Économie on desktop, Moyen on phone, Élevé on WebGPU.
- Fur flicker under the temporal anti-aliasing (Ultra, still camera): the fur layers add no visible flicker (average frame-to-frame variation about 0.7 on a 0–255 scale, with or without fur).
- Kit's own cost (draw calls / triangles; extra calls in the game view are shadows):

| Preset | Fur layers | Draw calls | Triangles |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ultra | 16 | 7 (12 in game view) | 310k |
| Élevé | 10 | 7 (12 in game view) | about 230k |
| Moyen (phone) | 6 | 8 to 12 | 106k (125k with the board) |
| Économie | 0 | 7 to 11 | 99k |

Two harness bugs were fixed in dev/kit/shot.js: star/shoes were set before a teleport that reset them, and Act 2 close-ups were taken before the board textures had arrived. I also added a private build script, dev/kit/mkbuild.sh, so I can compare against a baseline without the post role's unfinished edits. dev/kit/STATUS.md has the resume notes, the numbers, notes for the other roles and requests for you.

known_issues: Ultra preset on WebGPU renders black: the post pipeline's 5 colour attachments exceed WebGPU's 32-byte limit (post role); Kit could not be shot at Ultra on WebGPU.

Kit's mesh resolution (LOOK.res: 1.15 Ultra / 1.35 Élevé / 1.6 Moyen and Économie) is chosen from the preset at load only; changing preset later updates the fur layer count but not the body mesh density.
Spin-dash dust draws a hard-edged rectangle at ground level behind the ball (VFX, post role; dev/kit/shots/e1-spin.png).
A large see-through city fog billboard over the bay can cut a hard vertical edge through Kit in the flight cinematic when the camera is close (city role; also visible with ?nopost).
The e2e 'game over path' check fails when --only=desktop runs without boss (that test assumes the boss block returned to the title first); --only=desktop,valley,boss passes.
integration_todo: Commit src/30-player.js (the working-tree diff is this session's Kit changes only).

K.tex (12-tex.js): swapping a texture in place after it was uploaded as the 1x1 fallback triggers GL_INVALID_VALUE glTexSubImage2D on WebGL 2. Suggested fix: call t.dispose() before needsUpdate when the image size changes. Kit works around it by keeping its own placeholder until the texture's preload resolves.
Boot preloads only the 'act1' textures; consider also preloading 'common'.
Post role: the WebGPU Ultra pipeline exceeds 32 bytes per sample (5 colour attachments); pack the extra outputs or drop one on WebGPU.
Tests: the game-over check depends on the boss block when using --only; consider making it go to the title explicitly.
